sloka: मया हते संयति कुम्भकर्णे महाबले मुष्टिविकीर्णदेहे।विमोचिते वानरपार्थिवे च भवन्तु हृष्टाः प्लवगाः समस्ताः ।। ६.६७.७६ ।।
transliteration: mayā hate saṁyati kumbhakarṇe mahābale muṣṭivikīrṇadehe।vimocite vānarapārthive ca bhavantu hṛṣṭāḥ plavagāḥ samastāḥ ।। 6.67.76 ।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva has been caught. What is my duty now? I will do what is just. I will destroy that Rakshasa who is in the form of a mountain', thought Maruti.
